business_scope.primary_industry_name: Remote Desktop Access and Unattended Machine Telemetry Software

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (French-inspired, with residual Islamic law influence)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Egypt-United Arab Emirates Investment Protection Agreement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: AML/CFT framework: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering, as amended by Law No. 36 of 2014 and Law No. 154 of 2019; Executive Regulations issued by Prime Ministerial Decree No. 226 of 2008, as amended; Law No. 159 of 1981 on Joint Stock Companies, Partnerships Limited by Shares and Limited Liability Companies, as amended; Law No. 72 of 2017 on Investment; GAFI Commercial Registry and UBO filing regulations; Financial Regulatory Authority directives on ultimate beneficial owner identification and maintenance of UBO registers; Central Bank of Egypt AML/CFT rules on customer due diligence and beneficial ownership.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association of the LLC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Egyptian Notary Public through GAFI One-Stop Shop
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by the Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the relevant Egyptian Embassy or Consulate for foreign-executed signature pages; domestic execution requires notarization by an Egyptian notary.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney for non-resident shareholder or director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by the Egyptian Embassy or Consulate with jurisdiction over the notary; followed by legalization at the Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs if executed abroad.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Extract of the corporate register for any corporate founder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country Companies Registry or Commercial Register
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by the Egyptian Embassy or Consulate in the country of issuance; if Egypt is not an Apostille Party for the foreign document, apostille is not accepted as a substitute.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport copies and proof of address of directors, shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority, bank reference, or utilities provider in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified Arabic translation, notarization where applicable, and consular authentication of bank or utility verification letters issued abroad.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, signatories and ultimate beneficial owners against the Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit data, Central Bank of Egypt AML/CFT consolidated circulars, UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the domestic Egyptian designated terrorist persons and entities list. Politically Exposed Persons, their family members and close associates require enhanced due diligence, senior management approval, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth evidence, and event-driven rescreening at incorporation and throughout the life of the entity.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI One-Stop Shop and the Egyptian Commercial Registry electronic name clearance system under the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones, Ministry of Investment
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Arabic is the official language of the Commercial Registry. The company name must be acceptable in Arabic script; if a foreign-language name is used, an Arabic transliteration is recorded. Names must not be contrary to public order or public morals, must not be misleading as to the LLC purpose, and must not generate similarity to or confusion with pre-existing registered names or trademarks.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 15 business days of receiving a written commercial name rejection, the applicant or local counsel must file a reconsideration request before the GAFI Commercial Registry Director. The request must state the file reference, the legal basis for the requested name, corrected transliteration or nomenclature variants, and any ministerial approval required for sensitive tokens. If the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may appeal to the State Council under the Egyptian administrative litigation rules within 30 days from the final written refusal; the appeal must attach the original rejection notice and evidence of attempted administrative remedies. Parallel filing of a fresh name reservation with a different proposed name is permitted and recommended to avoid incorporation delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A licensed serviced office or verifiable virtual-office address may be accepted for a non-regulated remote software, remote screen share and IoT telemetry company, provided the address is a physical location, is not a PO Box, can receive service of process, and the office service provider is contractually obliged to maintain and disclose access to UBO, corporate records and books. Pure virtual offices without an underlying physical business footprint are not advisable and may be rejected during AML/CFT UBO inspections or by the Commercial Registry.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated 5-10% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months of incorporation and 15-20% within 36 months; inspection risk increases materially if UBO data is inconsistent, the registered office cannot be identified, or the financial/tax records do not match the registered address and payment processor KYC filings.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing per-page certified translation rate and translator notarization charges.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law No. 180 of 2018 (Companies Law), Articles 1-32 and Articles 26-32 (limited liability company incorporation); Executive Regulations Prime Minister Decree No. 96 of 2019; Law No. 72 of 2017 (Investment Law) for GAFI procedures.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Companies Registrar; Commercial Registry Office for trade registration
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association (Aqd al-Ta'sis); GAFI incorporation application form
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital for an LLC. Shareholders set the capital in the memorandum. Any cash contribution above zero must be deposited into a blocked temporary escrow account in the company's name and released after the incorporation certificate is issued; in-kind contributions require certified valuation. No escrow deposit is mandatory when the LLC is formed with zero or symbolic capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDERS AND FIRST BOARD OF MANAGERS 1. Share Subscription: Each founder subscribes to the quotas set opposite his name in the Memorandum. The capital is fully subscribed and the General Manager is authorized to register the shareholder roster. 2. Registered Office: The Company adopts the premises at [Cairo address] as its registered office. The General Manager is authorized to execute the lease and file all notices with GAFI. 3. Officers: [Founder A] is appointed General Manager and [Founder B] Financial Officer. Each may singly sign banking, tax and commercial registry documents within his authority. 4. Governance: The Board adopts the draft Articles and directs management to complete all statutory registrations and licensing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services Center - One-Stop Shop (online via GAFI Digital Services Portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create a GAFI e-profile for the proposed entity. Conduct an Arabic company name search (uniqueness and compliance with public order). Select the legal form 'Limited Liability Company' and upload the proposed activities aligned to ISIC 6201 (software publishing and remote telemetry). Submit the name reservation application and pay nominal reservation fee.
required_dossiers: Copy of founders' passports or national IDs
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If name similarity objection is raised, offer up to three alternative names and resubmit; if activity classification is inconsistent with the memorandum, request a technical code correction before finalizing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Authority for Notary Public / GAFI Notary Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the LLC Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association in Arabic, setting out shareholders, quotas, management structure and registered office. Have all incorporators sign. Notarize signatures and affix stamp duty as calculated under the fee schedule. Obtain notarized original copies for GAFI filing.
required_dossiers: Lease contract or title deed of registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary returns the document due to missing information, amend the document and republish the corrected edition; re-notarization is accepted as a corrected instrument.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Deposit and Blocked Account Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian commercial bank (in cooperation with GAFI and Central Bank of Egypt)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary/special current account in the name of the LLC at an Egyptian bank. Deposit the agreed cash capital, or no deposit if zero-capital LLC, and obtain a certificate of deposit/blocked funds. The bank will keep the funds blocked until the incorporation certificate is issued.
required_dossiers: Bank KYC forms and beneficial ownership declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank demands additional due diligence, provide certified source-of-funds documentation or a signed declaration; if the account is refused, present a second licensed bank application with a renewed resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission to the Companies Registrar at GAFI and Issue of Incorporation Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete e-file to GAFI with the notarized documents, capital deposit certificate, and registration fee. GAFI verifies the legality of the memorandum and the standing of managers. Upon successful review, GAFI issues the Egyptian incorporation certificate. The LLC acquires legal personality from the date of issuance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues an inquiry or rejection, cure defects by amending the memorandum, submitting clarification, or replacing incompatible managers; appeal to GAFI's complaint committee within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry Office / GAFI Tax One-Stop-Shop (Egyptian Tax Authority)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation certificate with the commercial registry to obtain the commercial registration number. In the same visit, register with the Egyptian Tax Authority for income tax (tax card) and VAT; register for payroll and social insurance with the National Organization for Social Insurance. Confirm the ISIC 6201 activity code and remote-services status.
required_dossiers: Tax forms (establishment form, VAT form if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax or registry classifications are challenged, supply the definitive ISIC code and a services narrative; reapply using the GAFI grievance window to correct codes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-formation Governance and Corporate Records Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company's General Meeting / Board of Managers; GAFI for register updates
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the constitutive meeting / first board of managers. Pass resolutions concerning quota issuance to founders, adoption of the registered office, appointment of the manager and alternate signatory, opening of the final bank account, and authorization for regulatory filings. Record these resolutions in the company's statutory minutes and register the quota list with GAFI's electronic register if required.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI queries changes in managers, file a revised Form of Appointment within the statutory notice period; maintain full minutes to cure any governance defect.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - Industrial Development Authority oversight is not engaged for ISIC 6201 remote software services; only GAFI general investment authorization applies
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required - remote desktop access and unattended machine telemetry software is an informational service activity, not manufacturing or physical industrial operation

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category C: no physical works or emission source; administrative office activities do not require an Environmental Impact Assessment under Law No. 4 of 1994 as amended
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: None applicable: zero process wastewater or industrial VOC emissions; electronic waste disposal, if any, complies with Law No. 202 of 2020 on waste management and EEAA guidelines

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: For the registered office and engineering/back-office facilities, obtain Civil Defense fire-safety approval for the premises, a structural conformity letter from the building owner/engineer where required, and an occupational health and safety clearance from the Ministry of Manpower. No environmental permit is required where no physical server or manufacturing floor exists.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance; online e-services portal at www.eta.gov.eg and e-invoicing platform at invoicing.eta.gov.eg.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign LLC that acquires Egyptian tax nexus must apply for VAT registration and a consolidated Tax Card (TIN) through the ETA electronic registration workflow. The applicant submits certified incorporation documents, board resolution, power of attorney, local fiscal representative appointment (where required), bank account evidence, and contact details. ETA validates the file and issues the national TIN/VAT ID and Tax Card.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egyptian law does not permit check-the-box or hybrid pass-through elections. An LLC is mandatorily taxed as a resident juridical entity under Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005. The only relevant elections are a non-calendar fiscal year approved by ETA and voluntary VAT registration for suppliers below the compulsory registration threshold.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax under Law No. 67 of 2016 and its Executive Regulations
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 of annual taxable supplies of goods and services in any 12-month period; imports of taxable goods or services require registration regardless of value.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt mandates electronic invoicing under Law No. 206 of 2020. Registered VAT taxpayers must transmit invoice data in real-time via the ETA Enterprise Integration Platform (EIP) using approved APIs; ETA validates the data and returns a unique QR code / invoice clearance ID before the supplier can present the invoice to the buyer. No physical stamping is required, but complete XML/JSON audit files must be retained.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods leaving Egypt are zero-rated upon proof of physical export. Services, including remote desktop access, screen sharing, and IoT telemetry software, are zero-rated when rendered to a non-resident recipient and the benefit is consumed entirely outside Egypt. Substantiation must demonstrate the non-resident status of the recipient, the foreign place of use, and the receipt of foreign currency consideration.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: For pure remote software/IoT services: ETA-approved zero-rated e-invoice, executed subscription agreement, server logs proving usage outside Egypt, and bank SWIFT credit advice showing inward remittance.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA may audit zero-rating claims and refund packets. Fraudulent or unsupported export zero-rating triggers retrospective VAT assessment plus late-payment interest, administrative fines under VAT Law No. 67 of 2016, and criminal sanctions for deliberate tax evasion or forgery. Refund claims remain subject to clawback for the statutory limitation period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) – Foreign Exchange Administration
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt maintains a managed float regime for the EGP. Current account transactions are generally free, but capital account movements require CBE approval via authorized banks. Profit remittances are permitted after settlement of corporate tax liabilities and submission of audited financial statements; however, banks apply enhanced scrutiny to large outward transfers, and access to hard currency can be rationed during periods of acute liquidity stress. Non-resident LLC shareholders may remit dividends net of the 10% distribution tax, subject to documentary proof of the underlying investment via the approved bank. The CBE has progressively relaxed surrender requirements but retains oversight over conversion timing to stabilize reserves.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Egyptian exporters must receive proceeds through an authorized bank and deposit into a foreign currency account within 30 days of the shipment date. Prior to the 2024 liberalization, 100% of export proceeds had to be surrendered to the banking system within 90 days; current regulations require conversion of at least 50% of the proceeds to EGP within 30 days, with the remainder retainable for trade-related current transactions, subject to CBE circulars. Software and digital service exports are treated as export receipts and must follow the same timelines, with invoicing supported by service contracts and customs or e-export documentation.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., UK FCA or EU-licensed e-money institutions) cannot be used as the primary operating bank for the Egyptian LLC. The CBE does not recognize foreign EMIs for domestic payroll, tax payments, or FX conversions. They may only serve as ancillary payment gateways for collecting global subscription revenue, but settlement to Egypt must route via SWIFT to a CBE-licensed bank. Any payment card issuing or local acquiring arrangement requires a partnership with a CBE-licensed payment service provider.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Egyptian banks require the legal representative (general manager or a director) to appear in person for a KYC interview at the branch. Remote opening is not permitted for foreign-owned LLCs. Non-resident directors may grant a notarized and apostilled power of attorney to a resident manager, but the POA holder must appear physically with the original POA and the director's passport. Original corporate documents certified by the Egyptian Commercial Registry and tax card must be presented in Arabic or with certified Arabic translation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction risks due to Egyptian AML/CFT strictness and the software company's non-resident shareholding structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Incorporation certificate, English and Arabic memorandum of association, shareholder registry with ultimate beneficial owner identification, board resolution appointing authorized signatories, audited financial statements or opening balance sheet, business plan demonstrating legitimate remote-support software operations, customer contracts and SaaS subscription invoices, evidence of registration with the National Telecom Regulatory Authority if needed, and a detailed source-of-funds declaration backed by bank statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected high-volume inbound international payments from Stripe/Paddle with no physical goods export
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial agreements with payment processors, platform settlement reports, IP licensing or software service contracts, ISIC/NAICS code certification, and a written confidentiality and data protection policy explaining the secure remote-desktop business model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outward profit remittance and foreign currency conversion risks
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tax clearance certificate from the Egyptian Tax Authority, audited financial statements, dividend distribution resolution, FATCA and CRS self-certifications, and prior CBE approval documentation for the original foreign direct investment deposit.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital injections must be routed via SWIFT MT103/MT202 from the parent shareholder's bank to an authorized Egyptian bank account designated as a Capital Escrow Account. The transfer must reference the CBE foreign investment registration code and Purpose Code 'FDI-Equity' or standard code 600110 (Investment in the capital of Egyptian companies). After CBE's automated settlement and issuance of a Foreign Investment Certificate, funds become unrestricted for operating expenses. For recurring subscription revenue from Stripe and Paddle, collections are aggregated offshore and swept to the Egyptian operating account via a monthly SWIFT credit with payment reference 'Sales of Software Services' and CBE Purpose Code 200420 (Export of Services).
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for software licensing, cloud infrastructure, and support subcontracts use SWIFT MT103 with Purpose Code 300220 (Payment for Other Services/Intangible Fees). For larger vendor contracts exceeding USD 50,000, a Commercial Letter of Credit (LC) may be opened at the Egyptian bank for payables backed by the underlying service agreement and CBE-issued import authorization. Domestic Egyptian counterparties settle in EGP via the RTGS (Egyptian Interbank Payment System – EGPS) or CBE's Instant Payment Network. FX is automatically converted against the interbank rate with a 0.5-1.5% spread depending on the bank and transaction size.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable forward contracts with a maturity limit of 12 months for receivables/payables arising from documented trade transactions
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed offshore to hedge EGP devaluation through an affiliate or parent level, subject to economic substance and CBE approval for onshore back-to-back structures
Cross-currency swaps between EUR, USD, and EGP for capital injection repayment schedules, permitted with prior CBE authorization
Plain-vanilla FX options for hedging subscription revenue exposure, subject to bank's internal mark-to-market and collateral requirements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return (self-assessment) under Law No. 91/2005
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - corporate taxpayers e-filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the end of the fiscal year; for a 31-December year-end, no later than 30 April of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing and late-payment penalties, statutory interest, enforced collection, tax card suspension, and possible criminal prosecution for wilful non-filing; continued non-compliance can block GAFI transactions and lead to administrative action.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited annual financial statements, auditor's report, and annual general meeting approval minutes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment (GAFI) companies records; retained at the Egyptian registered office and available to members
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual general meeting must be held and financial statements approved within six months after the balance sheet date; audited statements are submitted with the corporate tax return and made available to members before the meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to appoint an auditor or hold the annual general meeting exposes managers to fines and civil liability under Companies Law No. 159/1981 as amended; prolonged non-compliance may result in GAFI administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI - Beneficial Ownership Register (electronic BO platform)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually no later than 31 March for the preceding calendar year, and within 30 days after any shareholding change, including share transfers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties under Anti-Money-Laundering Law No. 80/2002 and GAFI implementing regulations for false, omitted, or late UBO data; managers may be subject to fines, imprisonment, and suspension of corporate filings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Register data confirmation and renewal (quinquennial renewal, annualised in this matrix)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registration Office - Ministry of Trade and Industry / GAFI one-stop shop
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal every five years from the commercial registration date; material changes such as registered office, managers, or capital must be filed within 15 days; annual confirmation of registered particulars is part of ongoing compliance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-renewal triggers fines under Commercial Registry Law No. 34/1976; continued lapse leads to administrative strike-off from the Commercial Register, after which the LLC cannot lawfully continue business until restoration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No revenue, asset, or employee threshold applies: every Egyptian LLC must appoint at least one independent licensed auditor from inception, regardless of size or turnover. The auditor must be registered with the Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority and the audited financial statements must accompany the annual tax return.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), issued by the Egyptian Accounting Standards Board and substantially aligned with IFRS; statutory financial statements are prepared in Arabic and in Egyptian pounds. IFRS may be used for group consolidation or supplementary reporting, but EAS governs the Egyptian statutory accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must maintain a beneficial ownership register and file an annual confirmation through GAFI's electronic BO register by 31 March. Any share transfer or change of ownership must be reported within 30 days of the transfer. A beneficial owner is any natural person directly or indirectly owning or controlling at least 25% of shares, voting rights, or equivalent control. If no change occurs, a no-change confirmation is still filed annually.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of members/quotaholders, including share and quota transfers
Register of directors/managers and their powers, appointments, and cessations
Minute book containing annual general meeting and management resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 - USD 900 per year for registered office or professional registered-agent services in Egypt
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200 - USD 3,500 per year for a low-risk, software/IoT-services LLC in Egypt

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% (standard Egyptian CIT on corporate taxable net income; Law No. 91 of 2005 as amended)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Small and medium enterprises with annual gross proceeds up to EGP 80 million may elect a turnover-based tax of 0.5% to 3.75% instead of the 22.5% net-income rate (Law No. 152 of 2020 and Law No. 6 of 2022). Export income exemptions, investment cost deductions, and free-zone/Special Economic Zone income concessions (50% investment-cost deduction; renewable 5-year/10-year tax holidays in SCZone and qualified free zones) further reduce effective rates. Software and IoT R&D expenses, if capitalized, are amortizable over five years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 5 (Corporate Income Tax Return) — mandatory e-filing via the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-services portal (eta.gov.eg).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; provisional quarterly tax prepayments are required in the interim period.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return must be filed within four months after the end of the fiscal year (calendar year by default; a different closing date accepted if the statutory books so provide).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross proceeds from remote-screen-share software subscriptions, unattended-machine telemetry, IoT monitoring fees, implementation and support services, net of VAT shown separately.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report revenue from Egyptian sales attributable to the local LLC; revenue earned by a foreign head office outside Egypt is excluded, and only the Egyptian branch share is entered.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 1b - Cost of Sales & Direct Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cloud infrastructure, IP license fees, data bandwidth, subcontractor remote-support costs, and capitalized software development expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recharges from the foreign parent must be evidenced by invoices, withholding certificates, and arm's-length benchmarking; unsubstantiated cost allocations are disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Staff Salaries and Social Insurance
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Salaries, bonuses, and employer social insurance contributions for personnel performing helpdesk, monitoring, and software engineering activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only Egyptian payroll and offices are included; salary costs recharged to or from the parent require transfer pricing support.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Straight-line depreciation on servers, telemetry equipment, and office assets; five-year amortization of development intangibles.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Branches apply the same Egyptian rates; no accelerated deprecation is permitted absent a statutory schedule; revaluation write-ups are not deductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate value of controlled sales, royalties, interest, and service transactions with foreign and domestic related parties, together with the TP policy.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compulsory when annual related-party dealings exceed EGP 10,000,000; local TP documentation must be indexed in the return for ETA inspection.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits for Egyptian withholding (e.g., 20% interest and royalty WHT, payroll-presumptive taxes) and provisional installments already paid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credits are taken in the name of the Egyptian taxpayer only; certificates (Form 15 WHT certificates) must be attached.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net operating loss available to be offset against current taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign losses and pre-registration losses cannot be set off; the loss year and the five-year expiry schedule must be reconciled.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a 2% per-month surcharge on the tax due (capped at 100% of the tax) plus a fixed non-filing fine; an estimated administrative assessment is issued for non-filing; false declarations trigger criminal tax evasion penalties under Article 139 of Law 91/2005.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 20 (Transfer Pricing Disclosure Form) attached to Form No. 5 in the ETA e-filing portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; attached to the income tax return.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Same deadline as the CIT return (four months after fiscal year-end).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of related parties, transaction categories (sale of software subscriptions, cloud services, IP royalties, loans), amounts, and the arm's-length method selected.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the foreign parent and affiliate jurisdictions, including the UAE or EU holding companies, and attach the TP benchmarking summary.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section B - TP Policy & Documentation Index
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Referencing the Master File, Local File, financial comparables, and economic adjustment rate adopted for remote IT services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm Egyptian residency of the tested party or justify the foreign counterparty selection with functional and risk analyses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Consolidated group revenue, country of the ultimate parent, and the entity's country-by-country allocation if group revenue exceeds the Egyptian CbCR threshold.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the foreign ultimate parent's jurisdiction and any CbCR filing reference applicable to the group.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to attach Form 20 triggers the presumption of an unsubstantiated related-party arrangement: the ETA may impose an income adjustment, deny cost recovery, apply the 2% monthly surcharge on additional tax, and charge a documentation penalty for absence of a required contemporaneous Local File.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% WHT on dividends distributed by the Egyptian LLC to shareholders, including non-resident shareholders; dividends derived by Egyptian resident corporate shareholders from previously taxed profits are generally exempt at the shareholder level.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a double taxation agreement, the non-resident shareholder must file the Egyptian treaty relief application with the ETA and submit: (1) a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the home jurisdiction covering the fiscal year of the distribution; (2) a statement of beneficial ownership and holding structure; (3) the relevant DTA article analysis. The Egyptian LLC may apply the reduced rate at source only after ETA acceptance, otherwise the 10% WHT is withheld and the excess is refundable through an ETA treaty-refund claim. All documents must be Arabic-translated/certified, and the LLC remits the WHT to the ETA within 15 days after the month of distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT is 20% on IP royalties and software license fees and 20% on debt interest paid to non-resident payees (10% for interest on certain bank finance if separately classified). Under Egypt's DTA network, treaty rates commonly reduce royalties and interest to 10%–15%, e.g., 15% under the Egypt-US treaty; relief requires the same TRC-based treaty procedure and is conditioned on the recipient being the beneficial owner.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 10,000,000 aggregate related-party transactions per fiscal year triggers the mandatory Local File/TP documentation and Form 20 disclosure; MNE groups with consolidated revenue ≥ EGP 12,000,000,000 are additionally subject to Master File and Egyptian CbCR notification/filing obligations.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not operate a UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations regime; substance is enforced through the General Anti-Abuse Rule (Article 33, Law 91/2005), Egyptian CFC rules, and the requirement that tax incentives, free-zone status, and treaty benefits are conditional on real activity in Egypt (employees, premises, management decisions, core revenue generation). A remote-support software LLC must evidence local R&D, contractual authority, and decision-making substance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly understating remote-screen-share and IoT telemetry subscription revenue, routing sales through foreign payment processors to avoid CIT, fabricating expense vouchers, or filing false Form 5 declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 139 of Law 91/2005, imprisonment from six months to five years and a criminal fine of multiples of the evaded tax (statutory range by court calibration), plus collection of the evaded tax with the 2% monthly delay surcharge and enforced administrative attachment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives who willfully file or approve false returns are prosecuted personally; the corporate veil is pierced for fraudulent conduct, exposing personal assets to civil restitution, freezing orders, and travel bans during the criminal tax investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the LLC as a paper entity with no employees or technical substance in order to issue fictitious invoices, absorb artificial management/technical service fees, or obtain incentives without engaging in actual economic activity in Egypt.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA invalidation of the artificial arrangements under Article 33 GAAR, disallowance of all deducted charges, recapture at 22.5% with the coupled 2% monthly surcharge, unpaid WHT on cross-border fees (20%), commercial registry deregistration, and revocation of the tax card.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or create fake invoices face civil recovery of the denied deductions, criminal forgery sanctions, and personal liability for the tax shortfall where the veil is pierced; the ETA may apply account freezes and director disqualification orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to register true ultimate beneficial owners with the Commercial Registry/GAFI, unawareness of sanctioned counterparties in cross-border subscription flows, or accepting settlement funds through Stripe/Paddle without bank KYC and AML record-keeping.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under AML Law 18/2021, fines up to EGP 1,000,000, freezing of bank accounts, suspension of the LLC's electronic payment/collection capability in Egyptian banks, and criminal prosecution of the designated AML officer and directors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the designated compliance officer incur personal criminal liability if suspicious cross-border transactions are recklessly processed; individual asset freezing, travel bans, and confiscation of monies connected to unlawful proceeds may be imposed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Documentation and Thin Capitalization Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Crossing the EGP 10,000,000 related-party threshold without a Local File, selling software subscriptions to a foreign distributor at margins outside the benchmarked range, paying IP royalties or intercompany interest without 20% WHT, or extracting profits through shareholder loans lacking arm's-length interest rate evidence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Compensatory TP adjustment of taxable income, disallowance of excess interest/royalty deductions, additional 22.5% CIT, a 2% monthly delay surcharge on the resulting tax, and penalties for failure to present contemporaneous documentation; treaty benefits may be refused for non-resident group members.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors attesting the Form 5 and Form 20 disclosures assume direct responsibility for material omissions; willful misapplication of TP rules is prosecuted under the tax evasion article, and the ETA can seize company bank balances and place personal liability on directors where the documentation defect conceals deliberate profit stripping.
